messages.content: The Glorietta Bay confirmation email only shows two adults. I don't see Owen anywhere, even though the room was supposed to be for all three of us. Can you verify that directly with the hotel?
Yes. I have reservation GBI-847261 for July 18-26 in a Deluxe Room with Two Queen Beds. Before I contact them, please confirm that the guests should be Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee, age 12.
Correct. I need his name and age attached to the reservation, but don't make any change that increases the rate without checking with me.
Understood. I'll ask the hotel to confirm three-person occupancy, verify that the existing two-queen room and bedding are valid for all three guests, and add Owen without changing the room or rate.
Also make sure they send a revised confirmation. I don't want to arrive and have the desk treat him as an extra guest.

I contacted the hotel. They confirmed that the reservation was received for two adults and one child, but the original guest-facing email displayed only the adult count. The Deluxe Room with Two Queen Beds permits three occupants, and no additional bedding is required.
Did they actually add Owen Lee and his age, or did they just confirm the room capacity?

They added Owen Lee, age 12, as the third registered guest. The hotel also confirmed that this does not change the $4,420 lodging total, taxes, cancellation terms, or the estimated $240 parking charge payable at the property.
And the updated confirmation has all three names?

Yes. The revised confirmation now lists Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee, age 12, for July 18-26 in the Deluxe Room with Two Queen Beds. The confirmation number remains GBI-847261, occupancy is recorded as two adults and one child, and the rate is unchanged. The corrected guest details are attached to the family itinerary for the pre-departure review.
